content.text:
2026 Sample Grand Prix Qualifying (Synthetic Circuit), AAA: 4 of 52 scored corners flagged as unusual (the top 1% of the session); 2 look like driving mistakes (3 flagged corners; neighbouring turns flagged on the same lap count once).
Laps scored: 1-10 of 10; 10 of AAA's 10 laps of the kinds the detectors score, which are push laps in qualifying and green-flag laps in races and sprints, slow ones included (never opening laps, in or out laps, or laps under yellow flags, a safety car or a red flag).
Biggest mistakes (all, ranked by time lost (only the part beyond the field's when the field was slow there too, and none of it when other cars explain it: being lapped, racing for a place or held up by cars already at the driver as the loss began, so such a flag ranks on the race-control bonus alone), plus 0.5 s when race control named the driver alone at that turn, discounted by up to half when the detectors found the corner only borderline unusual):
1. [track limits / off track (race control), also late throttle / wide exit] Lap 9, turn 3: 0.65 s lost, mostly on exit; lap time deleted for track limits at turn 3; 23 km/h slower at the exit and 2.2 m/s² less acceleration out of the corner.
2. [late throttle / wide exit] Lap 10, turn 4: 0.65 s lost, mostly on exit; 23 km/h slower at the exit and 2.2 m/s² less acceleration out of the corner. The same moment also shows at turn 3, whose windows overlap.
Time lost is against the driver's own usual laps at that turn (the field's when they had fewer than 5 other clean laps there), over 250 m before to 145 m after the apex. Call explain_corner with the lap and turn for the details and traces.
Flagged but not listed as mistakes: 1 not clearly slower than usual.
